settings.product: NOAA HRRR CONUS wrfsfcf00 analysis only, no substitute products
settings.pass_time: retain recorded model/selection-table acquisition times; four user-approved 52-second differences from older geometry bindings are explicitly retained
settings.spatial: equal-cell mean of grid centers covered by the same repaired Census urban polygons as Step6
settings.radiation_timing: interpolate sw/cos(zenith), then multiply by acquisition cosine; single usable ratio if the other cosine <0.1
settings.solar: inherited solar_times clock and solar_geometry harmonic declination at frozen city coordinates; UTC day of year; actual 365/366-day year
settings.weather_timing: linear interpolation of domain summaries for temperature, dewpoint, VPD and wind speed
settings.other_year_effects: all effect fields remain blank; no model or coefficient files read
settings.rainfall: retain prior 2023 descriptors; no new other-year rainfall retrieval in Step1
